what_happened.root_cause: All 25 alerts (created 2026-07-16 to 2026-07-17) were written by a pre-commit version of capture_trade_record() that used pmd schema {close_price, open_price, vwap, close_strength, scan_date} (5 fields). Current pipeline schema uses {scan_date, close, vwap, rvol, close_strength, range_pct} (6 fields). No combination of key names or payload structures reproduced the stored h1 from snapshot data. Original hash inputs are permanently irrecoverable.

session_a_action.what: repair_chain_snapshots.py rewrote stage_hashes[1_polygon through 6_decision] for all 25 alerts using CURRENT polygon_market_daily + options_structure_scan data (not original decision-time data). Stages 7-10 and audit_chain_sha256 left intact.
session_a_action.then: Commit a15eca8 (2026-07-30T16:38Z) deleted repair_chain_snapshots.py, added it to .gitignore, reverted pipeline INSERT to ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

session_b_action.what: aiem_options_alert_snapshots.polygon_data and oss_data rewritten for all 25 rows using pipeline-exact field structure ({scan_date, close, vwap, rvol, close_strength, range_pct}) read from current polygon_market_daily

verify_chain_sh_status.what_pass_means: Internal self-consistency between Session A's stage_hash rewrite and Session B's snapshot rewrite. PASS does NOT mean original decision-time data is preserved or verifiable.
verify_chain_sh_status.what_pass_does_not_mean: Original 2026-07-16/17 data integrity is not confirmed. polygon_market_daily had no captured_at column at the time; it is impossible to determine whether rows reflect intraday or EOD data.

forward_fix: polygon_market_daily.captured_at TIMESTAMPTZ column added 2026-08-01. All future inserts record exact write time. Existing rows backfilled with sentinel 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z to make the historical gap explicit.
